title: Intro to rhymer
text: rhymer 4 main functions allow get data related words Datamuse API. : get_rhyme() - function get rhyming words. get_means_like() - function get words similar meaning. get_sounds_like() - function get words sound similar. get_spelled_like() - function get words spelled similarly. also flexible function get_other_related() allows use API get data related words using series ‘codes’ described Datamuse API website. function default limited return maximum 10 results, can return . Functions also default return dataframe row word, associated score. Different functions return slightly different additional columns returning dataframe.
code: library(rhymer)

title: Intro to rhymer
text: function initial inspiration behind package. makes work finding rhyming words easy. background, referencing CMU Pronouncing Dictionary. ’s simplest, can pass word get_rhyme() return dataframe rhyming words. example: function additional arguments can use specify rhyme. can specify number syllables returned using num_syl: can specify type data returned using return_type: can also specify number words returned (defaults 10 kill API) using limit:
code: get_rhyme("test") ##          word score numSyllables ## 1    manifest 56054            3 ## 2       crest 41070            1 ## 3      detest 37033            2 ## 4  distressed 29032            2 ## 5        jest 26039            1 ## 6   impressed 23028            2 ## 7  acquiesced 21013            3 ## 8        rest 20062            1 ## 9       chest 20057            1 ## 10     arrest 20052            2 get_rhyme("test", num_syl = 2) ##          word score numSyllables ## 3      detest 37033            2 ## 4  distressed 29032            2 ## 6   impressed 23028            2 ## 10     arrest 20052            2 ## 11    bequest 19048            2 ## 12    request 19041            2 ## 13    abreast 19039            2 ## 17     attest 17049            2 ## 18    contest 17042            2 ## 20    protest 16048            2 # "df" returns a single dataframe (which is the default behavior). get_rhyme("test", return_type = "df") ## 6   impressed 23028            2 ## 7  acquiesced 21013            3 ## 8        rest 20062            1 ## 9       chest 20057            1 ## 10     arrest 20052            2 # "word" returns the type rhyme in the form of a single word vector. get_rhyme("test", return_type = "word") ## [1] "manifest" # "random_word" or "rand" returns a single, random word. get_rhyme("test", return_type = "random_word") ## [1] "acquiesced" # "vector" returns a vector of words. get_rhyme("test", return_type = "vector") ## text: say nothing rhymes orange… Feeling ? cloud words similar meaning happy:  Eminem wrote classic rap song ‘Lose ’, better rhymer?
code: get_rhyme("orange", return_type = "word") #> [1] "door hinge" word_data <- get_means_like("happy", return_type = "df") wordcloud::wordcloud(words = word_data$word,                       freq = word_data$score,                       colors = c("lightsteelblue1","lightsteelblue2","lightsteelblue3","lightsteelblue")) #> Warning in wordcloud::wordcloud(words = word_data$word, freq = word_data$score, #> : euphoric could not be fit on page. It will not be plotted. glue::glue("   His palms are sweaty   Knees weak arms are {get_rhyme('sweaty', return_type = 'word', num_syl = 2)}    There's vomit on his sweater already   Mom's {get_rhyme('already', return_type = 'word', num_syl = 3)} ") #> His palms are sweaty #> Knees weak arms are petty #>  #> There's vomit on his sweater already #> Mom's unsteady

title: Wrapper for the Datamuse API to Find Rhyming and Associated Words
text: rhymer 4 main functions allow get data related words Datamuse API. : get_rhyme() - function get rhyming words get_means_like() - function get words similar meaning get_sounds_like() - function get words sound similar get_spelled_like() - function get words spelled similarly also flexible function get_other_related() allows use API get data related words using series ‘codes’ described Datamuse API website. function takes basic arguments : word word base results return_type type data return (options df data frame, vector vector, word single word, random_word random word) limit max number related words return get_rhyme() get_sounds_like() also special helpers number syllables return called num_syl.
